findings.explanation: No purchase order document exists in the evidence set at all - PO-1005 is referenced by both INV-1005 and REC-1005 but was never supplied, so purchase authorization cannot be independently verified.
REC-1005 is dated 2026-07-18, three days before the 2026-07-21 invoice (INV-1005) it references, an inverted sequence in which the receipt predates the invoice it purports to support.
